Patios That Earn All Year

In Portugal, patios and terraces represent a huge business opportunity but only if they are comfortable during the cold season. With Solamagic infrared heating, you transform the exterior into a usable space 12 months a year.

Unlike gas braziers (with smoke and consumable costs), infrared is clean, efficient and instant. It heats people directly, without wasting energy heating the air.

Complementing the Solamagic range, ComfortSun outdoor heaters and ComfortSun multipurpose heaters offer more options for heating patios and terraces, with certified German TÜV technology.

Types of outdoor heating

There are several technologies for heating outdoor spaces. Each has ideal applications. We work with the most efficient:

Short-wave infrared (Solamagic)

The premium top tier. Instant heat, 92% efficiency, rain-resistant. Ideal for hospitality patios with rotating customers. Available with low glare lamps for nighttime spaces.

Medium-wave infrared (ComfortSun)

Versatile. Heats less intensely but more uniformly. Good price/performance balance for terraces, gardens, small and medium patios.

Heating towers (ComfortSun Polivalente)

Portable, no fixed installation. Ideal for events, weddings, markets and spaces where setup is temporary or layout flexibility matters.

Hospitality F&B: cafes, restaurants, gelaterias

High-traffic patios with customers needing quick seating decisions. Solamagic and ComfortSun Professional models with instant heat. Typical ROI in 1 to 2 years.

Real estate and private homes

How we dimension your patio (step by step)

  1. 1

    Free site visit

    We measure the patio, observe wind exposure, identify mounting points and electrical access. We discuss customer type and usage hours.

  2. 2

    Tailored technical plan

    We calculate total power required, number and layout of heaters, and estimate monthly consumption.

  3. 3

    ROI study

    We present an ROI estimate based on current patio occupancy and expected gain from extending the season.

  4. 4

    Fast installation

    In 1 to 3 days, no construction. Heaters mount on wall, pillar or stand, standard electrical connection.

  5. 5

    After-sales support

    Warranty, maintenance and lamp replacement. We are here when you need us.

FAQ

How to heat a restaurant patio efficiently?

The most efficient solution is short-wave infrared heaters. They heat people and objects directly, are wind-immune and turn on in seconds. For a typical 30 to 50 m² patio, 2 to 4 units are enough.

Does infrared heating work in wind?

Yes. Unlike conventional heating, infrared warms objects and people directly, not the air, so wind does not affect efficiency.

How much does revenue increase with heated patios?

Our hospitality clients report 40 to 50% increases in patio usage, extending the season by 3 to 4 months per year.

Are the heaters safe for outdoor use and rain?

Yes, Solamagic models have IP certification for outdoor use, rain protection and are safe for spaces with customers, including children.

What is the electrical consumption?

Models range from 900W to 3000W. With Solamagic carbon technology, consumption is up to 30% lower than conventional heaters.

Gas mushroom or infrared heater?

Infrared wins almost across the board: no smoke, no odors, no gas bottle, instant on/off, lower operating costs and better safety. Gas mushrooms also face regulatory restrictions in many municipalities.

How long does installation take?

Typically 1 to 3 days. Most units mount on wall, ceiling or stand, with standard electrical connection. No major construction.

Do you serve all of Portugal?

Yes. We are based in the Algarve and operate nationwide. For Algarve patios, we offer free technical visits within 24 to 72 hours.
